tolerance_rationale: H2 / STO-3G / RHF — every QC code agrees to better than 1 µHa. Anything looser than 1e-6 here would mean a real bug in two-electron integrals or SCF convergence.
published_source: Szabo & Ostlund Table 3.4 (RHF / STO-3G / R = 1.4 bohr); our R = 0.741 Å = 1.4006 bohr is within rounding.
